title: Ten years of research on the sound quality of cochlear implants
authors: Michael F Dorman; Sarah C Natale; Joshua S Stohl
supports: 已阅读出版方综述的问卷、匹配、声码器、限制与利益披露章节。区分 16 个项目中的 10 个已发表与 6 个未独立发表项目；不把设备关联或试点结果写成临床推荐。

title: Cochlear Implant Sound Quality
authors: Michael F Dorman; Sarah C Natale; Nadine Buczak; Josh Stohl; Francesco Acciai; Andreas Büchner
publication: Journal of speech, language, and hearing research : JSLHR, 68(1), 323-331
supports: 已核对正式摘要：255 位使用者、25 个描述词，开机早期由记忆回报，当前平均使用经验 4—8 年。支持描述变化及参照差异，不将回忆比较作为前瞻随访。

title: Sound quality, not speech recognition, explains cochlear implant-related quality of life outcomes
authors: Katelyn A Berg; Hugh M Birky; Victoria A Sevich; Aaron C Moberly; Terrin N Tamati
supports: 已通过 Europe PMC 阅读原文的参与者、远程呈现、SSQ/CIQOL 与言语任务、结果及限制。41 位成人横断面关联；SSQ Qualities 不等于单独的自然度评分，模型关联不支持因果推断。

title: Cochlear Implants: System Design, Integration and Evaluation
authors: Zeng, F.-G. et al.
supports: 系统框图、处理器、电极与评价问题；参照系统设计和子系统章节，不引用历史数量为现状。
verification: reuse existing verified registry; scope retained

title: Speech recognition in noise as a function of the number of spectral channels: Comparison of acoustic hearing and cochlear implants
authors: Lendra M. Friesen, Robert V. Shannon, Deniz Baskent, Xiaosong Wang
publication: The Journal of the Acoustical Society of America
supports: 声码器和真实人工耳蜗中通道数与噪声下识别的比较；不把早期设备样本的结果定义为当前所有用户的通道上限。 已阅读作者公开全文的摘要及相关方法段落。
verification: reuse existing verified registry; scope retained

title: Cochlear Place of Stimulation Is One Determinant of Cochlear Implant Sound Quality
authors: Michael F Dorman; Sarah Cook Natale; Leslie Baxter; Daniel M Zeitler; Mathew L Carlson; Jack H Noble
supports: 已核对正式摘要的两组共 7 位 SSD-CI 使用者及急性刺激位置改变；匹配频谱和基频随条件变化，支持位置为影响因素之一，不提供长期最优映射或设备排名。

title: Limitations on Temporal Processing by Cochlear Implant Users: A Compilation of Viewpoints
authors: Carlyon, R. P. et al.
supports: 已通过 Europe PMC 读取作者全文的引言、观点与讨论：时域音高和 ITD 限制、简单直接电刺激仍有困难、外周和中枢及经验依赖机制存在争论；七篇专家观点不是确定单一机制的临床试验。
verification: reuse existing verified registry; scope retained

title: Music perception with cochlear implants: a review
authors: Hugh J McDermott
supports: 已阅读正式摘要对早期音乐研究的综述：节奏、旋律、乐器音色与欣赏分开评价。用于历史任务差异，不将早期设备平均表现视为当代所有使用者的上限。

title: Perception of Environmental Sounds in Cochlear Implant Users: A Systematic Review
authors: Valeriy Shafiro; Nathan Luzum; Aaron C Moberly; Michael S Harris
supports: 已通过 Europe PMC 阅读综述的检索、纳入、任务比较和讨论。19 项研究，识别与检测区分、横断面占多数及前瞻证据不足；不把缺少整体改善证据解释为每人均无获益。

title: Changes in pitch with a cochlear implant over time
authors: Lina A J Reiss; Christopher W Turner; Sheryl R Erenberg; Bruce J Gantz
publication: Journal of the Association for Research in Otolaryngology : JARO, 8(2), 241-257
supports: 已核对原始摘要及音高随访范围：短电极混合型使用者的电—声音高匹配随经验改变，存在场次变异；该结果不等于所有声音自然度正常化。

title: Computer-based Auditory Training by New Adult Cochlear Implant Recipients Is Associated With Durable Improvements in Cochlear Implant Quality of Life
authors: James R Dornhoffer; Christian Shannon; Kara C Schvartz-Leyzac; Judy R Dubno; Theodore R McRackan
supports: 已阅读正式摘要：114 位新植入成人的前瞻观察、自报训练方式、一年结果；计算机训练与生活质量关联，未观察到同样言语收益。非随机设计，不推断训练造成自然度改善。

title: How to vocode: Using channel vocoders for cochlear-implant research
authors: Cychosz M, Winn MB, Goupell MJ.

title: The Sound Quality of Cochlear Implants: Studies With Single-sided Deaf Patients
authors: Michael F Dorman; Sarah Cook Natale; Austin M Butts; Daniel M Zeitler; Matthew L Carlson
publication: Otology & neurotology : official publication of the American Otological Society, American Neurotology Society [and] European Academy of Otology and Neurotology, 38(8), e268-e273
supports: 已核对正式摘要：8 位成人比较具体噪声/正弦/移频声码器与带限语音；另有 3 位年轻听者。本文仅引用成人实验的比较方向，不把不同任务、人群或实现的结果合并。

title: Acoustic simulation of cochlear implant sound to approximate the perceptual experience of electric hearing
authors: Kopsch AC, Plontke SK, Rahne T.
supports: 2026-10-09 已通过 Europe PMC 阅读原文的参与者、声级与呈现、优化流程、跨句比较及限制。15 位德语语后聋成人 SSD-CI；原句均值与标准差 9.7±0.5，新句 8.4±1.5、8.9±1.3，属同一批听者。仅支持同说话人的材料泛化，年龄相关对侧耳听力判据、选择条件及主观评分限制推广。

title: Close approximations to the sound of a cochlear implant
authors: Michael F Dorman; Sarah C Natale; Joshua S Stohl; Jenna Felder
supports: 已通过 Europe PMC 阅读参与者筛选、材料、处理、流程、结果及讨论。从 30 位中选择 10 位高匹配听者；记录带宽/展宽差异，以及某听者语音匹配带宽不等于电极音高范围的例子。

title: Effect of frequency-to-place mismatch on speech and music sound quality in acoustic cochlear implant simulation
authors: Louis Villejoubert; Lorenzo Picinali; Kathleen Faulkner; Deborah Vickers

supports: 已阅读正式摘要：23 位正常听力参与者，调整后的 MUSHRA、噪声声码器及频率—位置错配配置。仅支持声学模拟中的材料与配置依赖，不称为真实植入者临床验证。

title: Development and validation of a questionnaire for hearing implant users to self-assess their auditory abilities in everyday communication situations: the Hearing Implant Sound Quality Index (HISQUI19)
authors: Edda Amann; Ilona Anderson
supports: 已核对正式摘要：75 位 CI 使用者、19 项七级评分，衡量日常聆听自评能力与获益。只介绍验证范围与测量对象，不提供未经验证的中文翻译、常模或重印量表。
